340001.Text:
They are the Precursor clan, the masters of ancient civilization.

All Precursors became higher-dimensional beings through “ascension” and disappeared, but for some reason, the protagonist was unable to ascend to heaven and became trapped in a mysterious other world.

Years later, archaeologist Ada attempts to activate an ancient warp device and unintentionally summons the protagonist back to Dragona. 

Although the protagonist has lost most of his memories, he begins his adventure by helping Ada using the combat skills his body remembered.

340002.Text:
She is a Taoist belonging to the Confucian Academy. 
Taoists are people who are interested in the flow and balance of energy that fills the universe and strive to protect it.

Seoyoung, who defeated Nektari and prevented the deepening of the overlap, travels to Seohae on the Shinkiseon with the protagonist, Baekyun, and Belmond to deal with Black Mir.

Seoyoung learns that Black Mir released all the magical beasts sealed in the conduit, accompanied by the spirit ghosts who had contracted with the magical beasts, and that many monks were sacrificed in the process. 

After gathering her confused mind, Seoyoung saves Belmond and Baekyun, who fell into a trap with the main character, and together with them, succeeds in stopping Black Mir, who is trying to resurrect by creating a new body. 

With the Black Mir sealing project completed, everything seemed to be over, but an incident occurred in which Aria was kidnapped by Libra and Nectari, who coveted a being with spirit power.

Seoyoung, who moved to Nervas to save Aria, works with Balder, Bolt, and others she met there to stop Nectari from performing biological experiments on Aria, and to help calm down the Igni volcano, which was about to explode catastrophically due to Libra's evil plan.

Seoyoung also played a part in resolving the unprecedented situation in which Eclipse attempted to occupy Draeras.

340003.Text:
He is a member of the Orthos Mercenary Group, one of the strongest mercenary groups, and has reached a level that no one can match in terms of purely physical strength.

He is so fearless and rough that he wants to compete with a strong person, but he never does anything that violates the minimum standards of justice and is secretly affectionate. 

Due to this tendency, he has many enemies and friends. As a mercenary, he protects Ada, an archaeologist at the Talt Research Group, and encounters the protagonist for the first time, who has lost his memory and returned to Dragona. 

Hector meets the protagonist again in Granada, who was following Nektari's whereabouts.

Hector was also angry at Nektari's atrocities, so they worked together to uncover Nektari's conspiracy. 

In the process, he confronts Bolt, an Inhuman who gained great strength through Nectari's experiments. Hector, who noticed Bolt's soft heart, continues to persuade him to escape from Nectari's shadow.

340004.Text:
He is an Inhuman who was able to manipulate electricity freely as a result of Nektari's experiments.

Bolt was impressed by Nektari's doctrine and volunteered for the experiment, and became a faithful apostle who used the resulting power for Nektari's benefit.

But Bolt only thought that his actions would help create a better world.

Bolt's soft heart and strong belief in a bright future were a far cry from the atrocities committed by Nektari in secret.

However, through the protagonist's performance and Hector's persuasion, Nectari vaguely realizes that it is far from the organization he thought it was, and later, due to the volcanic incident in Nervas and the Silphywisp incident in Alteora, Nectari becomes a member of the group. Convinced that he has been deceived, Bolt helps the protagonist and his colleagues in their efforts to balance energy.

340005.Text:
He is a half-vampire, a hunter who hunts vampires while hiding his identity, and externally he is an executive of the largest financial institution under the Cargo Alliance.

Marius' mother became a Servant after being sucked by a vampire while pregnant, and he himself became a half-vampire. 

He escaped Eclipse, wandered around Skadia, and while growing his hatred for vampires, he caught the eye of a person and was adopted as an adopted son, who was the head of the Cargo Union's largest financial institution. 

Marius naturally established himself as one of Dragona's powerful figures, and used his power and wealth to support the Dark Hunters or directly hunt dark beings.

Marius ends up going to Ayers while searching for his mother's whereabouts. He eventually meets his mother, but she has already reached the point where she does not recognize her son and begins to attack Marius. 

At a time when Marius was hesitating and losing his judgment, Claire, who was digging into Eclipse's plot with the protagonist, kills Marius' mother to save him. 

Marius, who was momentarily angry and about to attack Claire, calmed down as time passed and began to see everything clearly. The fact that the reason my mother ended up like that was ultimately because of vampires...

From then on, Marius began to focus his efforts on helping the protagonist and his party stop Eclipse's plot.

340006.Text:
He is a member of the Numinus Church, which regards the ancient Precursors as sacred, and is the leader of the knights. 

Belmond was able to rise to such a position because of his sincere faith and the ability to connect to the Nexus, a collection of precursor consciousness. 

Of course, there were people who could connect to the Nexus before, but Belmond's ability to respond to the Precursor's consciousness was overwhelmingly high, allowing him to use unprecedentedly powerful divine power.

The protagonist is captured thinking that they are part of a group that steals and destroys relics, but the misunderstanding is soon resolved. 

Afterwards, they fight together against Libra, who thinks of relics as a way to make money, and Nectari, who arbitrarily interpret the doctrine of New Manus and carry out human experiments. and build trust.

When Draeras was in danger of being taken over by Eclipse, led by powerful Neo-Servants, he held firm while the protagonist's separate team attacked Neo-Servant-related facilities, ultimately leading to victory.

340007.Text:
They are the Precursor clan, the masters of ancient civilization. 

All Precursors became higher-dimensional beings through “ascension” and disappeared, but for some reason, the protagonist was unable to ascend to heaven and became trapped in a mysterious other world. 

Years later, archaeologist Ada attempts to activate an ancient warp device and unintentionally summons the protagonist back to Hyperia.

340008.Text:
Cindy was a girl from Arcina Academy who was very talented in handling fire magic. Nelia, the head of the fire school, favored Cindy, and Cindy also followed Nelia like a mother. However, Nelia was fascinated by the powerful power of fire magic and made a deal with Nectari. Nelia taught Cindy the fire magic she created by applying Nectari's techniques. The magic was very powerful, but she was afraid of going wild if she learned it too much, so she was reluctant to learn it herself. When Cindy eventually couldn't hold out and went wild, Nelia, worried that her negative actions would be revealed, framed Cindy for colluding with Nectari. When Cindy suddenly became a fugitive and was shaking with betrayal, she was able to shake off the pursuit with Trace's help. Trace was a member of Libra, which profited from the black market of ancient heritage, and helped Cindy because he thought her abilities would be useful. Cindy, who doesn't know this, completely gives in to Trace's warm hospitality. 

Cindy, who was active in Libra and spewing madness, is assigned to steal the artifact discovered by Ada of the Talte Research Group. And in the process of Ada discovering the artifact, she clashes with the main character, Hector, who was guarding Ada.

340009.Text:
A member of the Black Swordsman who received the revelation of the Heavenly King through Shinsoo and put it into practice. They share the same roots as the Taoist and the Young Hwan Temple, but they had a different ideology because they believed that in order to open the world that the Heavenly King sought, they had to directly intervene in the world, even if the method was somewhat extreme. Since most of the means chosen by the Black Swordsman to realize the revelation were assassinations, Shizuka also acquired techniques specialized in assassination. 

When the spirit of the Ultimate Demon King returned to Seoha for resurrection and the protagonists also arrived in Seoha in pursuit of it, the Black Swordsman was given two missions. They were to eliminate Im Yeong and the Young Hwan Temples who helped the Demon King's resurrection, and the protagonist, a race that broke the balance of the world and called for darkness (Precursors). Shizuka watched the protagonist closely and looked for an opportunity. However, the protagonists never spared their lives for each other, and all they did was save their comrades or try to stop the Ultimate Demon King's resurrection. Even though they suffered minor and major injuries from the surprise attack by the Black Sword Group, they focused all their energy on punishing the resurrected Mugeuk Demon King rather than on their own safety, and achieved a miraculous victory. 

Shizuka begins to question the way the Black Sword Group understands revelations and selects missions after making contact with the protagonist and the incident of the Mugeuk Demon King's resurrection. And in the process of uncovering Nectari's conspiracy with the protagonist at Cheongmyeongji, she comes to completely trust the protagonist.

340010.Text:
The Precursor clan, the masters of an ancient civilization. All Precursors disappeared into higher-dimensional beings through “ascension,” but for some reason, the protagonist failed to ascend and was trapped in a mysterious otherworld. 

After time passed, archaeologist Ada attempted to activate an ancient warp device and unintentionally summoned the protagonist back to Hyperia. Although the protagonist had lost most of his memories, he began his adventure by helping Ada with the combat skills his body remembered. 

Afterwards, the protagonist used the Precursor’s ability to communicate with ancient relics to solve problems that had occurred in Hyperia, including the overlapping phenomenon. In the process, he gradually regains his memories and meets many companions, realizing his situation and mission.

340011.Text:
Aria is a fusion of a human and a spirit with mysterious powers and infinite potential, but before that, she is a pure girl who wants no one to get hurt. 

A mysterious girl who was a prospective psychic with overwhelming talent, but who became an unprecedented being by fusing with a water spirit due to a certain incident. Aria, who has a pure and clear soul and a body that can turn her entire body into water, attracts the attention of many people. And naturally, she gets involved in many incidents. 

In particular, Aria's unpredictable ability leaves a stronger impression with the sealing incident of the Ultimate Demon King. The protagonist, Baek Yoon, and Seo Young were able to defeat the Ultimate Demon King with great sacrifice and tried to seal the Ultimate Demon King's soul in the sacred tree of Baekrim Village. While everyone was momentarily off guard, the Ultimate Demon King's soul coveted Aria's body. Soon, at the moment when he was about to swallow Aria's consciousness, the Ultimate Demon King succumbed to Aria's inherent power. Everyone who saw Aria's ability, which was beyond surprising and even bewildering, was astonished.

340012.Text:
The Precursors are the masters of an ancient civilization. All Precursors ascended to higher dimensional beings and disappeared, but for some reason, the protagonist failed to ascend and became trapped in a mysterious otherworld.

Many years later, archaeologist Ada attempted to activate an ancient warp device, inadvertently summoning the protagonist back to Hyperia. Although the protagonist had lost most of his memories, he began his adventure by assisting Ada with the combat skills he had memorized.

Later, the protagonist, utilizing the Precursors' ability to communicate with ancient relics, resolves the problems arising in Hyperia, including the overlapping phenomenon. Along the way, he gradually regains his memories and meets many companions, realizing his situation and his mission.

401999.Text: The Void Ruins are a place where the remnants of a corrupted dimension lie in ruin. Abyssion, the Herald of the Void who rules this place, uses the tentacles of Nemesis to communicate with other Heralds, seeking to plunge this world into eternal darkness. To prevent the threat of the Void from spreading further, the dimensional ruins—the very source of all this darkness—must be completely destroyed.
